description: After developing in the bone marrow, plasmacytoid dendritic cells travel in the blood to lymphoid organs. In mice they settle in the T-cell area of the spleen, and within hours of a viral signal they cluster in the marginal zone and the outer T-cell area. How they enter the spleen is less well studied than how they enter lymph nodes: mice lacking CCR7 have fewer in lymph nodes but normal numbers in the spleen.
